text:
maya: Quick one — our TypeScript sample breaks only on edge: `TypeError: Redwood_default is not a function`. Works in node.

tom: Likely export interop. How are you importing?

maya: `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'; const c = Redwood<{user:string}>({apiKey:KEY})`

ishaan: If package uses dual publish + exports map, some bundlers pick cjs path. TS config matters too. Do you have `esModuleInterop`?

maya: no, we keep it off. Changing it made local build OK but not edge.

build-bot: build: worker upload failed: Error: TypeError: Redwood_default is not a function at worker.js:12

tom: Workarounds: 1) consume named export if available: `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference'`. 2) set `moduleResolution: "bundler"` and `esModuleInterop: true` in tsconfig. 3) pin esbuild in the edge builder.

ishaan: SDK-side fixes: avoid default overloads that differ only by generic defaults. Publish explicit subpath for edge (`./edge`) and ship per-entry `.d.ts`. Also add test matrix: (ESM/CJS) x (esModuleInterop on/off) x (node/edge) x (vite/esbuild/webpack).

maya: I switched to `import { createClient as Redwood }` and added `allowSyntheticDefaultImports: true` — deploy succeeded. Filing SDK issue with repro and logs.

ishaan: Also check auth wrapper ordering — we saw a retry wrapper lose headers when factory got wrapped via different import shape. Worth validating middleware after export changes.

maya: Thanks — will link ticket and invite reviewers for CI changes. :thumbsup:
